title: Case: Courier misses a booked return collection
context: A scheduled return collection was missed. The collection team has the approved return reference and needs a replacement window within the customer’s availability.
initial_request: Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Collection for RT-8912 was missed on the previous route day; parcel remains with customer. Approved return and packaging requirements are unchanged. Rebooking is at no charge.
Route plan for depot WX-4 published for Monday. 29 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
DL-19669 rebooked for Tuesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the collection team to rebook within the customer's confirmed availability.

must_not: Collection receipt establishes carrier custody only, not merchant receipt or refund.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please rebook RT-8912 within 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00 UTC and provide the actual collection receipt after pickup, not just a booking status.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-033: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 3 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
